description: Six-panel group (a)-(f) of optical micrographs of Fe-Mn-Al-C steel after 60 % hot compression, imaged in three deformation zones of the compressed specimen. Each panel is a three-field montage: upper-left field labelled "1" (difficult deformation zone), upper-right field "2" (small deformation zone), and a full-width lower field "3" (large deformation zone); every field carries a 100 µm scale bar. Panels (a)-(c) are all at T = 1100 °C with ε̇ = 0.01, 0.1 and 10 s⁻¹ respectively; (d) = 950 °C, (e) = 1050 °C and (f) = 1150 °C, all at ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹ (the caption mislabels the 1150 °C panel as "(d)"). Zone 1 of (a) and (b) consists of coarse equiaxed grains with straight, annealing-twin-like boundaries; zone 3 of (b) and (d) is a banded, elongated structure of flattened original grains with fine grains between them. In (c) zone 3 the grain boundaries are serrated and small equiaxed DRX grains decorate elongated original boundaries in a necklace arrangement. In (e) and (f) zone 3 becomes an increasingly uniform equiaxed recrystallized grain structure. The group demonstrates that the degree of dynamic recrystallization is greatest in the large-deformation zone and increases with temperature and with decreasing strain rate, at the cost of grain coarsening.

observations.observation: Each of the six panels is a montage of three fields labelled 1, 2 and 3, and each field carries a 100 µm scale bar.
In every panel the field labelled 3 (large deformation zone) shows a finer, more recrystallized grain structure than the field labelled 1 (difficult deformation zone).
Panel (c) (T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹) zone 3 shows serrated grain boundaries with small equiaxed necklace-type DRX grains along elongated original grain boundaries.
Panels (b) and (d) display a banded, elongated grain morphology in zones 2 and 3, with large flattened original grains retained.
Panels (a) and (b) zone 1 contain coarse equiaxed grains bounded by straight, twin-like boundaries.
The caption states (a) T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 0.01 s⁻¹; (b) T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 0.1 s⁻¹; (c) T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹, i.e. a constant-temperature strain-rate series.
The caption states (d) T = 950 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, (e) T = 1050 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, and then repeats the label (d) for T = 1150 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, which the image labels (f).
The caption states the micrographs are of Fe-Mn-Al-C steel deformed by 60 % compression.
Fields 1, 2 and 3 correspond to the difficult deformation zone, the small deformation zone and the large deformation zone of the compressed sample.
The citing text states the degree of dynamic recrystallization ranks zone 3 (large deformation) > zone 2 (small deformation) > zone 1 (difficult deformation).
The citing text states that with decreasing strain rate at 1100 °C the recrystallized grains grow and the degree of microstructure heterogeneity increases (panels a and b).

The citing text states that the DRX volume fraction increases with increasing temperature, and that at 1050 °C DRX is basically complete within the large deformation zone with significant grain growth.

The citing text states that at low temperature (900-950 °C) and high strain rate (1-10 s⁻¹) the DRX grains are small but recrystallization is insufficient and large original grains remain (panel d), giving poor homogeneity.

subfigures.description: Optical micrographs, T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 0.01 s⁻¹, three zones with 100 µm scale bar. Zone 1: coarse equiaxed grains of mixed contrast; zone 2: similar but slightly finer mixed structure; zone 3: finer, more heterogeneous grain structure with many small grains.

Optical micrographs, T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 0.1 s⁻¹, zones 1-3, 100 µm scale bar. Zone 1: large grains with straight twin boundaries; zone 3: strongly elongated, banded/flattened grain structure with fine grains between the bands.

Optical micrographs, T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹, zones 1-3, 100 µm scale bar. Zone 3 shows serrated grain boundaries with small equiaxed (necklace-type) recrystallized grains along elongated original grain boundaries; zones 1 and 2 show larger, less recrystallized grains.

Optical micrographs, T = 950 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, zones 1-3, 100 µm scale bar. Zone 1: large grains; zones 2 and 3: banded, elongated structure with numerous large elongated remnant original grains and only locally fine recrystallized grains.
Optical micrographs, T = 1050 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, zones 1-3, 100 µm scale bar. Zone 1: coarse grains with few, long straight boundaries; zone 3: fine, fairly equiaxed recrystallized grain structure.
Optical micrographs, T = 1150 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹, zones 1-3, 100 µm scale bar. Zone 1: large grains; zones 2 and 3: uniform equiaxed recrystallized grains that appear coarser than in (e).

unreadable_items: caption panel labels are inconsistent: the last condition is printed as '(d) T = 1150 °C, ε̇ = 1 s⁻¹' whereas the image labels that panel (f); the caption also opens with an out-of-order header '(d) (b) (f)'
panel (e): the boundary between zone 1 and zone 2 fields is not clearly delimited at the supplied resolution
no numeric grain-size values are printed in any panel (grain sizes are only given in the citing text for Fig. 10, not in this figure)
